correctness.rationale: Exact 16-vertex Cayley graph yields 48 edges and 32 triangles, all 16 choose 2 dual edges and 176 connected triples; 48 diamond and 12 square tetrahedra have free triangular path faces. Sixty elementary collapses reduce dual to dimension 2. The spanning clique torus π1=Z² maps surjectively to dual π1; both four-cycle generators bound 3-simplices. Therefore π1=0. Euler χ=12 and dimension 2 give free H2 rank11; Hurewicz/Whitehead establish dual wedge 11 S². Integral Alexander duality gives original reduced H11=Z^11 and no other group. Checker reproduced f-vector and boundary ranks for primes 2,3,5; finite-field checks are only supplementary.

evidence: The relevant prior 3-cut families require no four-cycles, no triangles, rectangular path grids, or Cartesian products of complete graphs.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The 4-cycle-free theorem does not apply because Shrikhande has 4-cycles; the triangle-free and quadrangulation statements do not apply because it has 32 triangles. The path grids have boundary and different adjacency. The all-parameter rook theorem cannot specialize to a non-isomorphic strongly regular mate; identical parameters do not imply identical cut-complex homology.
